thread:
alex_sales: Quick heads up — Finulus legal asked if we can be a drop-in replacement for CompAI for their billing team. They want a short POC + security questionnaire answers. Any immediate blockers?
sam_se: We can map endpoints, but watch out for session semantics and token billing diffs. Do they expect identical JSON shapes?
devon_soleng: They use session_id anchored conversation history. We can accept session_id and map to our conversation_id in a gateway shim. Perf note: mapping adds ~10ms p95.
morgan_se: Also prompt-parity issue: CompAI auto-injects system role. Their clients rely on that. Gateway shim or client upgrade required.
jamie_security: Security Qs: SOC2 Type II ✅, KMS supported ✅, VPC peering & private options available. Need Finulus security contact to start questionnaire. We support data retention controls and audit logs.
alex_sales: Pricing ask from Finulus: need rough per-conversation cost vs CompAI. Any back-of-envelope?
sam_se: Token accounting differs. Our billing = prompt_tokens + completion_tokens. CompAI streaming counts may vary. For parity, assume ~1.05x tokens due to role metadata unless trimmed. Recommend reserved capacity for stable unit economics.
alex_sales: Can we give them a curl smoke-test they can run that maps headers and simulates their session flow?
devon_soleng: Yes — sample:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/compat" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FINULUS_TEST_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"session_id":"s-123","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize Q3"}]}'
```
Response difference example:
```
// CompAI
{"id":"resp_1","text":"Q3 was strong ...","tokens":124}
// Redwood
{"conversation_id":"c-789","generated_text":"Q3 was strong ...","generated_tokens":130}
```
We can add a compatibility layer that rewrites keys.
morgan_se: I can run an eval harness against their 50 canonical prompts and produce a delta report (latency, token delta, content diff). Will need sample prompt set and expected outputs.
jamie_security: Legal also wants subprocessor list and encryption-at-rest details. I have the doc links; will DM the SOC2/pdf and subprocessors link to Alex.
alex_sales: Timeline: Finulus wants a POC by next Tue. Can we provide staging creds + 2-week eval window?
sam_se: We can. Need network allowlist IPs, and if they want KMS key binding, need key ARN and IAM role. Confirm whether they demand on-prem deployment.
devon_soleng: Note: Private/on-prem takes longer — typical lead 8-10 weeks and procurement for infra. Mention it upfront to avoid blockers.
jamie_security: I'll prepare a one-pager for sales with answers to common security Qs and an attachable SOC2 snippet. Sending to Alex via DM :lock:
alex_sales: Great — I'll reply to Finulus with the POC plan, ask for prompt set and security contact. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
